Solution A: **** **Company Confidential – Internal Distribution Only** **Memo** **To:** All Employees (Technical & Non‑Technical) **From:** Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) **Date:** 20 Aug 2025 **Subject:** Updated Data Security Protocols – Immediate Action Required --- ### 1. Executive Summary Recent cybersecurity incidents worldwide—ranging from sophisticated ransomware campaigns to targeted credential‑replay attacks—highlight a rapid evolution in threat methods and an increasing willingness of adversaries to exploit even the smallest misconfigurations. Key trends that impact us: | Trend | Impact | Why it matters to us | |-------|--------|---------------------| | **Credential‑Reuse & Password Compromise** | 35 % of breach compromises in the last 12 months began with stolen or weak credentials. | Our legacy user pools still contain shared and under‑managed accounts. | | **Supply‑Chain & Zero‑Day Exploits** | 12 % of corporate breaches in 2023 involved third‑party vulnerabilities. | We rely on numerous SaaS and open‑source components that require continuous scrutiny. | | **Data‑Loss & Ransomware** | 78 % of losses were due to encrypted data with no backup. | No‑touch data retention and backup policy updates have revealed gaps. | | **Social Engineering & Phishing** | 60 % of successful attacks exploit staff awareness. | Our latest phishing simulation showed 18 % of staff fell through. | In response, we are rolling out an immediate, layered set of security controls that align with the **NIST Cybersecurity Framework** and **ISO 27001** best practices. These measures are designed to protect **people, processes, and technology** while keeping operational disruption to a minimum. --- ### 2. Updated Security Measures (All Employees) | Area | New Requirement | How to Comply | Deadline | |------|-----------------|--------------|----------| | **Authentication** | *Multi‑Factor Authentication (MFA)* is mandatory for all corporate accounts—both internal and remote. | • Download & install the company‑approved MFA app.
• Use the same login credentials as before; the MFA setup prompt will appear the next time you log in. | 29 Aug 2025 | | **Email & Web** | *Email‑Based Phish‑Protection* – all inbound mail will be scanned for known malicious URLs and attachments. | • Do NOT click links in emails that look suspicious or are from unknown senders.
• Use the “Report” button in Outlook or Gmail to flag suspicious content. | Continuous | | **Device Management** | *Endpoint Protection* – all laptops, phones, and tablets must run an approved anti‑malware agent. | • IT will push the agent automatically.
• If you have a personal device used for work, register it with the Mobile Device Management (MDM) portal. | 5 Sep 2025 | | **Data Handling** | *Data‑Leak Prevention (DLP)* – sensitive data (PII, financial, intellectual property) is monitored on all endpoints and cloud storage. | • Do not copy sensitive data to personal drives or unencrypted cloud accounts.
• If you need to share sensitive documents, use the company’s encrypted file‑share (MyDrive Secure). | Continuous | | **Patch Management** | *Automated OS & Software Updates* – updates must be applied within 48 h of release. | • Enable automatic updates on all devices.
• IT will handle critical security patches for servers. | 1 Sep 2025 | | **Reporting** | *Security Incident Reporting* – any suspected threat must be reported via the ticketing portal (INC‑Tracker). | • Email IT or hit the “Report Security Issue” button in the portal. | Immediately | **Key Takeaway:** These controls are in place to protect **you**, your data, and the company’s reputation. Please complete the MFA prerequisite and review the employee training module (link in your dashboard) by 29 Aug. --- ### 3. Technical Guidance for IT & Security Operations *(This section is distributed in a separate EPIC‑ticket to the IT team. If you’re not in the IT Security group, please ignore.)* **A. MFA Deployment** 1. **Auth Server** – The company authenticates via Azure AD B2C. 2. **Policies** – Enforce MFA for all privileged accounts and for all user accounts that access external SaaS. 3. **Recovery** – Enable Microsoft Authenticator as the default MFA method. Users can optionally enroll in Duo (fallback). **B. Endpoint Protection** 1. **Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR)** – Install CrowdStrike Falcon on all Windows, macOS, and Android devices. 2. **Configuration** – Enforce real‑time monitoring, script quarantine, and automated rollback. 3. **Reporting** – Generate weekly compliance dashboards in Power BI for audit managers. **C. Network & Data‑Loss Prevention** 1. **Firewall Rules** – * Block inbound traffic from known malicious IP ranges (update daily via threat feed). * Allow outbound VPN traffic only from the corporate proxy. 2. **DLP Policy** – * **Pattern Matching** – Credit‑Card numbers, SSNs, API keys. * **Action** – Block or quarantine outbound email or file transfer that matches patterns. 3. **Logging & SIEM** – Log all firewall events in Splunk. Tune to surface events with `action=allow` in suspicious subnets. **D. Patch & Vulnerability Management** 1. **Discovery** – AGENT‑Sweep scans the network for missing patches (OWASP Top‑10). 2. **Remediation** – Patch windows via WSUS; schedule non‑critical patches for nightly maintenance windows (2–4 a.m. UTC). 3. **Escalation** – Vulnerabilities with CVSS ≥ 9.0 must be remediated within 24 h. **E. Encryption & Key Management** 1. **Data at Rest** – All servers must use BitLocker or FileVault with MFA‑based unlock. 2. **Keys** – Azure Key Vault will store all encryption keys. Access is logged, with role‑based access control. 3. **Transport Security** – All internal traffic must be TLS 1.3 or higher. **F. Incident Response** 1. **Playbooks** – Updated IR‑playbooks covering ransomware, insider threat, and PoC exploits. 2. **Communication** – Use the incident‑tracking portal to notify the CISO and relevant business units automatically. 3. **Remediation** – Follow the “Contain‑Kill‑Recover” framework (see attached playbook PDF). **G. Supply‑Chain Vigilance** 1. **Vendor Vetting** – Review all third‑party code included in releases. 2. **Software Bill of Materials (SBOM)** – Generate SBOM for all new deployments via Overlay. 3. **Secure DevOps** – Shift‑left testing using Snyk and Qualys. --- **Action Items for IT (Due 5 Sep 2025):** - Push MFA rollout to all user groups. - Deploy EDR agents and confirm coverage metrics. - Update firewall rule base and verify push to all border devices. - Schedule patch windows; notify affected business units. - Approve the new IR playbooks in the ticketing system (Ticket #IT-IR-2025). **Next Steps for All Staff:** - Complete MFA enrollment by 29 Aug. - Review and pass the updated cybersecurity quiz (link in Employee Portal). - Start using “SecureSend” for all PII transmissions.
